```{r}
# load data
data <- read.csv('/data/vision/beery/scratch/shir/codes/movebench/notebooks/Carter_Red_Fox_merged_df.csv')
data=clean_names(data)
colnames(data)
ggplot(data)+geom_jitter(aes(x=gps_satellite_count, y=algorithm_marked_outlier), alpha=0.5)
ggplot(data)+geom_jitter(aes(x=gps_hdop, y=algorithm_marked_outlier), alpha=0.5)+geom_vline(xintercept=9.9)

ggplot(data)+geom_jitter(aes(x=speed_m_s, y=algorithm_marked_outlier,color=gps_hdop==9.9), alpha=0.5)#+xlim(0,30)
```
